sn1.37:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ mahāvane mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhim pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi sabbeh-eva arahantehi ||
sn1.37:1.3: dasahi ca lokadhātūhi devatāyo yebhuyyena sannipatitā honti Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya bhikkhusaṅghañca || || 2.
sn1.37:1.4: Atha kho catunnaṃ Suddhāvāsakāyikānaṃ devatānam etad ahosi ||
sn1.37:1.5: Ayaṃ kho Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ mahāvane mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi sabbeh-eva arahantehi ||
sn1.37:1.6: dasahi ca lokadhātūhi devatāyo yebhuyyena sannipatitā honti Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya bhikkhusaṅghañca ||
sn1.37:1.7: Yannūna mayaṃ pi yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkameyyāma || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavato santike pacceka gāthaṃ bhāseyyāmāti || || 3.
sn1.37:2.1: Atha kho tā devatāyo seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāham pasāreyya || pasāritaṃ vā bāham sammiñjeyya || evam evaṃ Suddhāvāsesu devesu antarahitā Bhagavato purato pātur ahesuṃ || || 4.
sn1.37:2.2: Atha kho tā devatāyo Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhaṃsu || ||
sn1.37:2.3: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho ekā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn1.37:4.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn1.37:6.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
